What's new »

Automated calls and text message reminders about fines – watch for scams
We sometimes make automated calls and send text message reminders to people who owe fines. Find out how to tell if a call or text is genuine.

Got a fine to pay?

You can pay online here by credit card.

Pay now

Find us

Locate courts, tribunals and offices
Victims Information website launch
The Victims Information website has relaunched with clearer, more accessible information for victims of crime, their whānau, and supporters.
Parliament passes new firearms laws
Parliament has passed the Arms Bill to repeal and replace the Arms Act 1983, completing a comprehensive rewrite of New Zealand’s firearms laws.
Increases to the Offender Levy
From 1 July 2026, the Offender Levy increased from $50 to $100.
